name: medel/translator
description: Offline, dependency-free translation engine for plain text and HTML fragments. Dictionary + heuristic resolution, pivot languages, protected-term placeholders and a local SQLite/JSON cache. Zero HTTP requests, zero external APIs.

suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Enables the fast SQLite cache backend (the cache falls back to JSON automatically when missing).
suggest.ext-iconv: Only used as a fallback for multibyte case folding on exotic platforms.

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the dependency-free smoke test suite (no PHPUnit required, works offline).
scripts-descriptions.test:acceptance: Checks that the markup, the entities and the emojis survive in every language.
scripts-descriptions.test:i18n: Data integrity and translation quality: correct script per language, no Spanish leftovers, no duplicated punctuation and no node lost between pivot legs.
scripts-descriptions.glossary:lint: Checks the hand written article glossary: valid UTF-8, correct script per language, punctuation kept, and no clash with the shipped dictionaries.
scripts-descriptions.glossary:build: Merges the article glossary into data/*.json. Add --check for a dry run, or language codes to write only those legs.
scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Measures time, memory and cache cost against a real page.
